title: TY McDonald's Beanie Baby " Libearty the Bear " 1996 RARE SEALED
descriptionText: The product is a rare, sealed TY McDonald's Beanie Baby from 1996 called "Libearty the Bear". This collectible plush toy is part of the Beanie Babies Collections by Ty, appealing to fans of all ages. With its nostalgic charm and limited availability, this item is a highly sought-after piece for collectors and fans of vintage toys.
